lines.text: Every how-to video plays at the same speed, whether you keep up, or not.
Falls are the second-leading cause of unintentional injury death worldwide.
In one survey, three in four people didn't finish their home physical therapy exercises.
And most cardiac arrests outside hospital happen at home, where nobody is checking your form.
At least nine in ten deaf children are born to hearing parents.
And a video can't see whether your hands are right.
InStep is the video that waits for you.
lines.say: In Step is the video that waits for you.

lines.text: Prop up your phone or laptop. It becomes the camera: an external camera, not the TV.
Pose tracking runs in its browser. Only body points travel to the TV: numbers, never video.
This is Fall Prevention, on the Vega Virtual Device. At each key moment, the lesson pauses, and continues only when your pose is right.
It counts your reps and times your balance. If you're stuck, it offers one short, kind tip.
Safety comes first. No balance work until a chair is beside you. And if the camera drops, the lesson stops, and waits.
Sign Language for Families teaches hand shapes, letter by letter.
The hands are illustrated, and not yet reviewed by Deaf signers. Learn with Deaf teachers, too.
For kids, the lesson is a story.
The forest waits until they're a tree, a mouse, and a flamingo.
The same engine runs hand rehab, and CPR rhythm: practice only, not certification.
And two people can practise together, each with their own phone.
A physiotherapist or teacher records a lesson once, on a phone.
InStep finds the still moments, suggests the steps, and publishes it to the TV.
lines.say: In Step finds the still moments, suggests the steps, and publishes it to the TV.

lines.text: Every lesson is an open file, called .istep: a video, plus the poses it waits for.
lines.say: Every lesson is an open file, called dot eye step: a video, plus the poses it waits for.

lines.text: The phone sends body points over a WebSocket. A small server relays them to the TV.
One pure TypeScript gate engine, shared by the phone, the server and the TV, decides when to move on.

lines.text: And the gated video player is open source, for any Vega app.
